obligations.evidence: State has the active predicate github-write-is-pending, but the page's dedicated persistence displays say the status is unknown. The header summary reads 'Remote persistence: not reported', and the 'Persistence status' region (desktop full.png bottom, 'Remote persistence (runtime-reported)') reads 'Remote persistence status has not been reported. Do not assume work is saved.' The only pending signal is an obligation item, 'OPEN Github write is pending — Work still required.', plus the blocker link in Actions. So the page both shows the write as pending and says remote persistence status was never reported.
